findings.title: Amount Claimed does not match sum of hospital bill and pharmacy bill
findings.detail: The claim form states an amount claimed of 60878.77, but the hospital bill total payable of 60200.77 plus the pharmacy bill of 678.00 sums to 60878.77, showing a discrepancy or arithmetic mismatch against the claimed total depending on items included.

findings.title: Billed USG Abdomen lacks a standalone report
findings.detail: The hospital bill includes an USG Abdomen charge, but no standalone USG Abdomen report document is found in the file (only mentioned in the discharge summary).

findings.title: Pharmacy invoice outside hospital location and admission window
findings.detail: The pharmacy bill is from Bengaluru while the hospital and patient are in Noida, and the pharmacy invoice date (16 Sep 2024) is on discharge day for outside purchase.
